title: Be a licensed employment agent
what: Carry on, or advertise, the business of an employment agent only while licensed (for a firm or body corporate, through a licensed member or officer).

sources.title: Employment Agents Act 1976 (WA)
sources.publisher: WA Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: no person shall carry on, or advertise, notify or state that he or it acts as, or carries on the business of, an employment agent, or that he or it is willing so to act or carry on business, unless — (a) being a natural person, he is the holder of a licence under this Act

administration.who: Commissioner designated under the Employment Agents Act 1976 (WA)
